definition: Seppo Ilmari Linnainmaa (born 28 September 1945) is a Finnish mathematician and computer scientist known for creating the modern version of backpropagation.
details: Published the master's thesis in 1970 detailing the modern algorithmic method for automatic differentiation, which powers backpropagation.

explainer.lead: Seppo Linnainmaa is a Finnish mathematician and computer scientist.

contributions.name: He received his MSc in 1970 and introduced a reverse mode of automatic differentiation in his MSc thesis.
